_doc: SOT-2623 — existing-MATCH sentinel set for the mandatory focused verification gate.
WHY THIS EXISTS (cycle2 adversarial review H1, docs/ai/cycle2_adversarial_review.md):
Each cycle-2 child (SOT-2614/2616/2620/2621) verified itself on a 'focused set' built ONLY from
its abstain-recovery target idx. That set contained NONE of the existing-MATCH questions, so a
child that silently broke an already-correct answer (MATCH->WRONG) could still report 'wrong
non-increasing' and PASS. The cycle-2 integration (SOT-2622) then surfaced 3 such regressions
(idx4/62/94 MATCH->WRONG) that NO child's focused set could have caught — the focused gate had no
regression detector. This file pins a FIXED, cross-type set of existing-MATCH questions that
scripts/run_focused_gate.py ALWAYS runs alongside a child's target idx: if any sentinel drops from
MATCH the gate FAILs (exit != 0). It is a regression tripwire, not a coverage claim.
CHAMPION / GOLD SOURCE:
champion  = SOT-2610 Wave A (RAG_DET_PIPELINE_ROUTER=1 over the r1 champion), gold100 = net40
(match47 / abstain46 / wrong7; artifacts/gold100_sot2610_waveA.json).
gold      = artifacts/predictions_test_v3_final.csv (the SAME gold gold_offline uses; judge=codex).
NO new gold values are hardcoded here — 'expected_verdict: MATCH' is champion's own
recorded verdict, re-checked live by the runner; no answer text is embedded in this file.
SELECTION BASIS (fixed 10, cross-type, det+LLM, STABILITY-VETTED):
The serve path is nondeterministic (Gemini), so a sentinel must be an answer champion gets right
*reproducibly* — a single-sample MATCH is not enough. Each index below was confirmed MATCH under
the champion env across MULTIPLE independent live samples (the SOT-2610 gold100 plus SOT-2623
vetting runs), and flaky single-sample MATCHes were rejected. In particular the 3 H1 victims
idx4/62/94 were deliberately NOT used: they are the fragile answers (idx4 picks the wrong column,
idx62 loses the rank ordering, idx94 over-enumerates) — using a fragile question as the baseline
makes the tripwire false-fail. Two axes are balanced on purpose:
* TYPE (6 archetypes): version_diff, highlight_set, fact_lookup, enum_set, derived_calculation,
document_extract — so a regression in any answer family trips the gate.
* ROUTE (both answer paths guarded): 3 answered by a deterministic Wave-A pipeline WITHOUT the
LLM loop (byte-exact, the most reproducible), and 7 by the LLM investigator loop (chosen to be
exact-scalar / exact-list answers, the most stable LLM class). 'route' is the path OBSERVED
during vetting; it can vary run-to-run (the router only takes the deterministic path when its
pipeline grounds a value), so run_focused_gate.py records the ACTUAL observed route each run.
MAINTENANCE: keep exactly 10, keep the type + det/LLM balance, and only swap an index if champion's
verdict for it stops being reproducibly MATCH — re-vet from fresh champion samples, never hand-edit a
verdict or embed a gold answer.
